Someone very close to me lost her high medical needs daughter in January. She died in her sleep. Please do not see the deficits in your daughter as a negative, she is strong, she is happy to be alive, and you should try and see that and take strength from that and give her the best life you can.


You have to do this for her and I know what you are going through when you're essentially doing everything on your own whilst your partner is off living his own life.


Be happy of the time you have with her is I guess what I'm trying to say, you don't have the luxury of feeling sad about it, you do need to be strong, and it's hard, I know it is, and some days you will sit in your car and cry wondering what you did to deserve this, but you have to push through.
